data.body:
[P2] Establish a regression test for the Windows staging failure

CONTRIBUTING rule 5 requires a failing regression test before the fix, and the contribution guidelines require related unit tests. This change adds none. The existing `packaging.test.ts` only checks staging strings and would still pass if the broken `DEP_NAME` expression were restored. The reported local name-resolution check does not exercise the Windows/MSYS failure, leaving it outside normal PR regression coverage. Please return to the design phase under rules 8 and 9 to establish a reproducer and validation approach for this boundary.
